title: Bridging the Morphology Gap: Adapting VLA Models to Dexterous Manipulation via Intent-Conditioned Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2606.12109v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models offer semantic and spatial priors for robot manipulation, but their parallel-gripper interfaces leave multi-finger contact coordination implicit. Adapting these models requires both timely grasp transitions and embodiment-specific hand trajectories. We introduce InDex, an intent-conditioned framework that connects these two requirements. A normalized aperture signal, derived from retargeted demonstrations, supervises a scalar grasp intent while preserving full hand-action supervision. Stage 1 learns synchronized end-effector-intent chunks; Stage 2 conditions a diffusion hand decoder on these predictions, visual-language context, and proprioception. Sequential optimization establishes the upstream interface before learning dexterous control with low-rate co-adaptation. translated_title: 弥合形态差异：通过意图条件化微调将VLA模型适配到灵巧操作
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供了语义和空间先验，但其平行夹爪接口使得多指接触协调处于隐式状态。适配这些模型既需要及时的抓取转换，也需要与本体的手部轨迹相匹配。我们提出InDex，这是一个连接这两项需求的意图条件化框架。从重定向演示中导出的归一化开合度信号用于监督一个标量抓取意图，同时保留完整的手部动作监督。第一阶段学习同步的末端执行器-意图数据块；第二阶段基于这些预测、视觉-语言上下文以及本体感知，对扩散手部解码器进行条件化。通过顺序优化，先建立上游接口，再以低速率协同适配的方式学习灵巧控制。在四个仿真任务中，采用π0.5的InDex实现了85.8%的平均任务成功率，相比原生策略有所提升。
tldr: 提出InDex意图条件化微调框架，利用由演示重定向导出的归一化开合度抓取意图信号，将预训练VLA模型从平行夹爪适配到多指灵巧操作，在四个仿真任务中达到85.8%的平均任务成功率。
en_tdlr: We introduce InDex, an intent-conditioned fine-tuning framework that adapts pretrained VLA models from parallel grippers to multi-finger dexterous manipulation via a normalized aperture grasp-intent signal, achieving 85.8% mean task success across four simulated tasks.
